$comment: Career card sleeves (CAREER_SLEEVES in progressModel.ts): card backs, drawn on card faces and deck boxes.
style: Card backs: one upright card back per cell, front view, perfectly flat and symmetrical, all the same 5:7 rectangle with slightly rounded corners and straight edges; nothing sticks out past the card's edge. The whole card is ONE flat solid field of the accent ink named by the subject (printed like a solid letterpress block, with its speckle), with a thin ivory border inset from the edge and one bold ivory emblem in the centre, carved like the other pictograms. Each card fills about 90% of its cell's height.
spare: a card back in deep green-black accent ink with an ivory diamond
